scope.description: Whole Elmer FEM finite element and multiphysics application breadth.
scope.denominator: General geometry/dimensions, solid thermal, mechanics, electromagnetics, acoustics, coupled fields, transient/nonlinear solutions, parallel/adaptive execution, result/restart and interactive workflows.

coverage.rationale: A useful complete layered steady solid-conduction family is integrated, including material/source/end alternatives and verified restart/result interpretation. Nearly all general geometry, physics, transient/nonlinear, coupling, parallel and interactive families remain excluded.

scope.description: Layered constant-area insulation and solid-heater conduction with source, end-condition and sampled-limit intent.
scope.denominator: Domain decisions within this bounded declared workflow: ordered materials, SI quantities, heat generation, outward flux/film conventions, native results and inspectable acceptance; excluded upstream features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Users author material resistance, heating and end conditions instead of native mesh/SIF syntax. The adaptor generates native models, retains full-precision measured temperatures, derives explicitly signed heat rates, checks exact conservation and enforces sampled criteria. Explicit mesh cells and sampled-only limitations remain user decisions.

limitations: Serial perfectly contacting one-dimensional constant-property solids only; no general geometry, transient, radiation, nonlinear/coupled physics, CFD or MPI. Native VTU ASCII haseight-significant-digitnificant digits; full-precision native ASCII restart supplies tables and physics checks.

Editorial estimates are not measured API percentages or native qualification. Limits concern nodes and midpoint flux; no mesh-convergence or continuum-envelope guarantee. Upstream patch identity is source provenance because the binary reports major.minor only.
